title: Make empty timestamp specification executable and fail on undefined steps
description: Full BDD run exposed a silently skipped existing cutoff scenario: the step regex requires nonempty timestamps although the feature tests an empty timestamp. Fix the step binding, and make the runner fail on skipped/undefined non-WIP steps so CI cannot report false coverage. Preserve explicit @wip filtering. Verify every runnable scenario and report pending specs separately.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Release review also found a hardcoded 0.3.0 version-output expectation; change it to verify the current package version so subsequent release bumps retain the tested contract. Preserve @wip filtering while failing any otherwise undefined/skipped step.

comments.text: Product CI 39428517097 failed only ARM musl: new automatic-snapshot-cleanup BDD step directly executes CARGO_BIN_EXE_botspy and gets Exec format error under cross/QEMU at tests/steps/sqlite_steps.rs:186. 289 other scenarios passed; eight other CI jobs and receipt gate passed. Fix the harness without skipping the scenario or changing production behavior; then run focused checks and new-head CI. No blind rerun or merge attempted.
